messages:
Jo Chen (CEO): Quick follow-up from the all-hands: customers want a concise "one-stop" summary for SOC2 readiness, BYOK rotation behavior, and exactly what audit logs we can hand off for Private deployments. Can we get owners + short deliverables so Sales/CS have copy to send?

Ava (Security): Ill own the SOC2 readiness checklist and the evidence portal structure. Plan: standardize artifact names (controlID_artifactType_date) and produce a small demo video showing where auditors find screenshots/logs. Need Legal for control language and Platform for sample exports.

Liam (Infra): For VPC/Privatelink: Ill publish a compact checklist (CIDR guidance, flow log bucket patterns, private DNS entries) and a minimal terraform example. ETA: 2008002200 (Fri EOD). Snippet: ```hcl
resource "aws_vpc" "redwood_private" {
  cidr_block = "10.10.0.0/16"
}
resource "aws_flow_log" "flow" {
  log_group_name = "/redwood/private/flow"
}
```

Diego (Platform): Audit export options: we can deliver ndjson dumps to customer buckets or stream to their SIEM via signed forwarder. Ill produce an example export job and auth model. Important note: for EU-only custody we need the export target to be region-bound and the customer's KMS keys to be EU-region KMS.

Priya (Legal): Ill review the artifact naming convention and produce the control narratives. Reminder: any contractual claim about "EU-only custody" must be backed by region-locked storage + KMS and a DPA addendum. Also retention >3 years requires Privacy sign-off.

Nina (Privacy): On PII: before exporting detailed request traces to customers or auditors, we should offer automatic PII redaction rules (email, SSN-like patterns) or a hashed token option. Ill draft a short anonymization spec and examples.

Ava (Security): SOC2 evidence portal ETA: 2008003000 (next Tue). Deliverable: live tracker with controls -> artifacts + a 3-min demo recording. Owner: Ava.

Diego (Platform): Audit export CLI example (ndjson) ETA: 2008002600 (Mon): ```bash
redwoodctl export-audit --start 2026-02-01 --end 2026-02-07 --format ndjson --dest gs://customer-logs-eu/ --sign-job
```

Liam (Infra): For on-prem HSM integration we need to capture VIN and schedule a validation window. Ill open an ops request and list required customer artifacts.

Priya (Legal): Also note: BYOK rotation paragraph for customer docs should state that Redwood supports key aliasing + staged rotation to avoid downtime, but customers are responsible for their KMS policies. Ill draft the exact wording.

Jo Chen (CEO): Good. Sales also asked for a one-paragraph explanation of how BYOK rotation avoids downtime; that should be included in the BYOK FAQ.

Ava (Security): Will include a short BYOK FAQ: staged rotation, dual-key accept period, and rollback steps. ETA: 2008003000.

Nina (Privacy): Also: propose a checkbox in the export flow for "redact PII"; default off for auditor exports, on for customer exports unless customer opts out in contract.

Diego (Platform): I'll add that flag to the export API spec and note the caveat in the CLI examples.

ops-bot: Recording/transcript uploaded: https://redwood.internal/recordings/2008001112 (SSO).

Jo Chen (CEO): Please add owners, deadlines, and links to the compliance workspace. If exec unblock needed, ping me. Can we reconvene in a short sync next Tue to confirm the portal demo?

Ava (Security): Ack  will post tracker and calendar invite. :thumbsup:
